o1: Enables DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific; RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity; and enzyme inhibitor activity. Is predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription factor activity. Involved in several processes, including defense response to other organism; determination of adult lifespan; positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II; maintenance of intestinal epithelial structure; response to toxic substance; innate immune response; and intestinal differentiation. Predicted to be involved in intestinal epithelial cell differentiation. Is part of a multi-pathogen defense pathway. Located in nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including Ea; Eal; anal region; head neurons; and intestine, and is also expressed in neurons. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in adenocarcinoma (multiple); artery disease (multiple); atrial fibrillation (multiple); congenital heart disease (multiple); and pancreatic hypoplasia-diabetes-congenital heart disease syndrome. Orthologous to human GATA4 (GATA binding protein 4); GATA5 (GATA binding protein 5); and GATA6 (GATA binding protein 6).
